functional_reqs.requirement_text: The mobile application shall be available on Android devices.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Platform availability on Android is explicitly stated and is a core product scope requirement.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The mobile application shall be available on iOS devices.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Platform availability on iOS is explicitly stated and is a core product scope requirement.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view current football news for their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams"
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Displaying team-specific news is a direct end-user capability described in the research.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to individually select preferred sports channels for news content.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "and also select preferred sports channels individually."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Individual channel selection is a configurable user feature explicitly requested.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide a live ticker for users to follow the results of their favorite teams live.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Live ticker access for favorite teams is a core functional capability of the app.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of national football leagues and competitions.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: National competition coverage is explicitly included in the content scope.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of international football leagues and competitions.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: International competition coverage is explicitly included in the content scope.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view detailed team information at any time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Always-available team details are directly described as required content.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view detailed player information at any time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Always-available player details are directly described as required content.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall display live stream links from supported providers when a live broadcast has begun.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Displaying live stream links conditionally when broadcasts start is a specific user-facing feature.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall restrict the display of live stream links based on transmission rights in the user's country.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained. Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Rights-based regional availability is explicitly required for legal compliance and correct feature behavior.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to retrieve live results of their favorite teams in real time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The LiveFootball app should also give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Real-time result retrieval is a direct functional requirement stated separately from general live ticker support.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves and displays live data in real time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: The presence and role of the live ticker module are explicitly defined.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The live ticker module shall communicate with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This describes a specific functional interaction between internal components that is necessary for live updates.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall retrieve live data for the live ticker via an API from an external server.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This defines the required source and integration mechanism for live data retrieval.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app"
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: User-specific configuration through app modules is explicitly described as supported functionality.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide a notification function that informs users about current events when activated.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Event notifications are explicitly described as an app feature contingent on user activation.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide user registration at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Registration is directly required and its point of access is specified.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide user login at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Login is directly required and its point of access is specified.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to follow favorite clubs.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs"
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Following favorite clubs is a key personalization feature explicitly requested.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about news related to their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Notifications about favorite-team news are explicitly named as part of personalization.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about results related to their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Notifications about favorite-team results are explicitly named as part of personalization.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to share news via social media directly from the app.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Social sharing of news is an explicit end-user feature.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to share game reports via social media directly from the app.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app."
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Social sharing of game reports is an explicit end-user feature.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall be fully loaded and ready for use within 2 seconds after startup.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a measurable performance requirement with a clear threshold.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide a user interface that enables users to access app information directly.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a usability/accessibility quality requirement concerning interface design efficiency.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application's user interface and modules shall remain consistent even when external server updates occur.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This describes a stability and architectural consistency expectation under changing server-side data.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The registration and login process shall be uncomplicated for users.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a usability requirement, though qualitative, expressing the expected ease of authentication.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall function reliably even with limited network coverage.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a reliability requirement for adverse connectivity conditions.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall remain usable offline during temporary loss of network connection.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Offline usability is a resilience/availability requirement under disconnection scenarios.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users without performance loss.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a measurable scalability and performance capacity requirement.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall undergo thorough testing before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a quality assurance process requirement intended to improve release reliability.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The product organization shall provide support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Support readiness is explicitly mentioned as part of the quality process and contributes to operational reliability.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The product organization shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a continuous improvement and product quality management requirement.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall process all personal user data in compliance with GDPR.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: "Data protection is our highest priority. All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This is a mandatory legal and security/privacy compliance requirement.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app.
evaluation.issue_identified: Partially inaccurate and incomplete. The source states that additional modules allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface. The requirement omits the interface-connection capability and uses vague wording ('additional modules') without defining the user-visible function clearly.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide configuration modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect those modules to the user interface.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide a notification function that informs users about current events when activated.
evaluation.issue_identified: Too vague. 'Current events' is underspecified compared with the source and later requirements, which indicate notifications about news and results of favorite teams. This requirement should be aligned to user-relevant event types or narrowed to activation behavior.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide a notification function that, when activated, informs users about relevant current events, including news and results related to their favorite teams.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide a user interface that enables users to access app information directly.
evaluation.issue_identified: Misclassified as a non-functional requirement. This describes a product function/user capability rather than a quality attribute. It is also vague ('information').
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide a user interface through which users can directly access available app content and features.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application's user interface and modules shall remain consistent even when external server updates occur.
evaluation.issue_identified: Ambiguous and potentially misleading. The source states that modules and UI are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates, but 'consistent' is not measurable. The intent appears to be architectural independence from external server updates.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: External server updates shall not alter the application's installed user interface components or module structure.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The registration and login process shall be uncomplicated for users.
evaluation.issue_identified: Subjective and not testable. 'Uncomplicated' is not measurable.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The registration and login process shall be designed for completion directly at app startup with minimal user steps.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall undergo thorough testing before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
evaluation.issue_identified: Process-oriented organizational statement rather than a product non-functional requirement. 'Thorough' is also unmeasurable.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: Before release, the product shall pass a defined pre-release test process intended to identify and resolve malfunctions.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The product organization shall provide support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
evaluation.issue_identified: Not a product requirement; this is an organizational/process requirement. Also unclear what 'support processes' means before release.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The organization shall define and execute pre-release support and issue-resolution processes to identify and resolve malfunctions before release.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The product organization shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.
evaluation.issue_identified: Not a product requirement; this is an organizational/process requirement rather than a system non-functional requirement.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The organization shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to support ongoing product improvement.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide user registration at app startup.
evaluation.issue_identified: Potential overstatement. The source says registration and login can be completed directly at app startup, not necessarily only at startup or forced at startup.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to complete registration directly at app startup.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide user login at app startup.
evaluation.issue_identified: Potential overstatement. The source says registration and login can be completed directly at app startup, not necessarily only at startup or forced at startup.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to complete login directly at app startup.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide a live ticker for users to follow the results of their favorite teams live.
evaluation.issue_identified: Duplicative with FR-012 and FR-013. The same capability is restated multiple times with minor wording differences.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide a live ticker that enables users to follow the live results of their favorite teams in real time.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to retrieve live results of their favorite teams in real time.
evaluation.issue_identified: Duplicative with FR-005 and overlaps FR-013. This should be consolidated with the live ticker capability.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to retrieve real-time live results of their favorite teams through the live ticker.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves and displays live data in real time.
evaluation.issue_identified: Overlaps heavily with FR-005, FR-012, FR-014, and FR-015. It is acceptable as a design-level functional requirement, but the set contains redundancy.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves live match data from the external API and displays it in real time via the user interface.

evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of national and international football leagues and competitions.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of international football leagues and competitions.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-006 because both derive from the same source and describe a single coverage scope requirement.

evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about news and results related to their favorite teams.

evaluation.issue_identified: Missing requirement. The source explicitly states that users can select favorite teams for news and can follow favorite clubs, but there is no explicit requirement that users can set/manage favorite teams as a preference for content personalization. FR-020 covers favorite clubs only, which may not fully capture team preference management used by news and live results features.
evaluation.new_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to select and manage favorite teams for personalized news, live results, and notifications.

evaluation.issue_identified: Missing requirement. The source states that live stream links are available from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport as soon as the live broadcast has begun. While FR-010 covers display after start, there is no explicit requirement that the app integrate supported streaming providers as link sources.
evaluation.new_requirement_text: The application shall integrate live stream links from supported broadcast providers, such as DAZN and Sky Sport.

evaluation.issue_identified: Missing requirement. The source explicitly states that the live ticker module continuously updates current match data. Although FR-014 mentions this, there is no standalone quality/performance requirement for update continuity during live matches.
evaluation.new_requirement_text: The live ticker shall continuously refresh displayed match data while live data is available from the external server.
